name: Bukkake Tenshi Silky & Milky
original_name: ぶっかけ天使シルキー＆ミルキー
source:
One night two lights jumped into main character's room. They turned into two girls - Silky and Milky. They are heavenly warriors chasing the runaway fallen angels. It turns out that protagonist happens to be the source of the energy required for their activities in the human world. Will girls catch fallen angel if hero complies?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一天夜里，两道光芒飞进主人公的房间，化作名为希尔奇与米尔奇的两名少女。她们是天界战士，正在追捕逃亡的堕天使。二人很快发现，主人公恰好是她们在人类世界活动所需的能量来源。如果主人公愿意配合，她们能成功抓住堕天使吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
